<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/ems/summary/devices"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Query the energy consumption summary (today, yesterday, last 7 days, last 30 days, last 365 days) aggregated for the given list of devices (unit: kWh).
Supports filtering by endpointId.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
